summary_1line: Vaka teaches Indra that independence and humble hospitality bring true happiness; later Narada settles a dispute between kings Suhotra and Sivi over who should yield.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra, radiant on a seat of honor, questions the aged sage Vaka in a hermitage while offerings of water, fruits, and roots lie before him.
Two royal chariots halt face to face on a forest road as kings Suhotra and Sivi refuse to yield, while the celestial sage Narada appears between them.
A humble Brahmana serves food first to guests and ancestors before quietly eating the remaining rice in his simple home.
